dedupe_keys.name: cableinspect ad electrical conductor anomaly images

description: Hydro-Québec publishes high-resolution electrical-conductor images and COCO annotations for anomaly detection in robotic power-line inspection. Its specialists modified three transmission-cable types in a laboratory and photographed them with controlled lighting and camera motion on 19 April 2023. Defect categories include melted strands at several severity levels; the release is labelled as an unscheduled update. The provider page offers a public archive at no charge and states CC BY-NC 4.0. The research project page instead says CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, so the rights conflict must be checked before redistribution. Coverage is a laboratory sample of utility cable types, not field failures over time. The provider warns that the images do not represent every anomaly and makes no completeness guarantee. Simulation use includes testing visual fault-observation reliability for line-maintenance models. It complements data-nasa-prognostics-data-repository with conductor images, not machine time series. Neither archive nor masks were downloaded.
name: CableInspect-AD electrical-conductor anomaly images
notes: G8; G8-0611. Metadata and documentation checked. Data payloads and software execution were not tested. Simulation uses are curator interpretations.  Cited as: CableInspect-AD authors (2024). CableInspect-AD: An Expert-Annotated Anomaly Detection Dataset. NeurIPS 2024; arXiv:2409.20353..
